name: Ingrid Karlsson
bio:
Ingrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Growing up in a small town in Sweden, she was fascinated by the complex machinery of her father's forestry equipment. This early exposure sparked a passion for engineering that led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduation, she initially worked in the automotive industry, but the allure of motorsport proved too strong. She joined a small rally team, cutting her teeth in the demanding world of off-road racing before transitioning to circuit racing.

Her meticulous approach to problem-solving and her ability to extract the maximum performance from any car quickly earned her a reputation as a highly effective engineer. Ingrid believes in fostering a collaborative environment within her team, encouraging open communication and the sharing of ideas. She is known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to make critical decisions quickly and decisively. At Century Motorsport, she's focused on pushing the boundaries of vehicle performance while cultivating the next generation of engineering talent.

What sets Ingrid apart is her holistic approach to engineering. She doesn't just focus on the numbers; she understands the importance of driver feedback and uses this information to fine-tune the car's setup. This unique blend of technical expertise and intuitive understanding makes her an invaluable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a practical bun
physical.description: Ingrid is a woman of average height with a strong, determined face and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even to meetings.
Insists on having a specific type of Swedish coffee blend available at all times.
Has a habit of sketching out technical diagrams on napkins during lunch.
